purpose: Contract for owner-valid unattended Second Shift work with durable claim/lease semantics, bounded retry behavior, immediate successor reconciliation, all-rungs exhaustion proof and auditable utilization events.

owner_control_binding.branch_head_rule: Canonical owner systems bind valid_for_control_head to the exact live owner branch head.
owner_control_binding.file_blob_rule: A product-root lane may bind valid_for_control_head to the exact Git blob SHA of an authority-selected repository file declared by the owner selector. This is used when binding the lane to the root authority file avoids a self-invalidating main-commit dependency while still invalidating the delegation whenever root authority changes.
owner_control_binding.authority_equivalence: For validation, the resolved exact hash of the declared owner control binding is the owner control head. A FILE_BLOB binding does not grant different authority; it only defines the exact root control identity.

admission_rules: Owner path must resolve through SYSTEM-TOPOLOGY-002.json or be the SYSTEM_MASTER product root itself.
valid_for_control_head must equal the exact resolved current owner control binding at revalidation time: live branch head for BRANCH_HEAD or declared exact authority-file blob for FILE_BLOB.
READY requires a concrete completion delta and stop condition.
A changed control binding invalidates READY/CLAIMED for mutation until re-evaluated against the new authority.
Only one mutation-capable claim may be live per owner lane.
A completed or superseded objective must be removed from active_delegations and successor selection performed in the same reconciliation while shift time remains.
Human, author, private-data, external-authority and native-platform blockers cannot be bypassed by Second Shift, but they block only dependent work.
A-01 work additionally requires a currently registered qualifier, exact subject SHA and current policy admission.

A stale or missing delegation, completed assignment, blocked critical path, transient dependency, unavailable A-01 slot, unavailable runner or empty active list never by itself proves no safe work exists.
State-changing effects are treated as at-least-once delivery and require durable idempotency keys/deduplication.
Transient dependency retry is finite and classified; after budget exhaustion the worker records a circuit-open event and switches to independent safe work when available.
SYSTEM_MASTER-owned non-system headless capability portfolios share the SYSTEM_MASTER product-root lane; tool creation alone does not create a new Second Shift owner lane.

checks: resolve the owner's declared current control binding
compare the resolved exact control hash with valid_for_control_head
read the obligation registry selected by CURRENT-AUTHORITY rather than a historical hard-coded registry
verify objective remains open in current owner state
verify active claim/lease standing and last checkpoint
verify idempotency/deduplication before any repeated effect
verify exact subject and qualifier for A-01 work

completion_rule: On completion or material block, preserve evidence, release/retire the current claim/delegation, re-read live owner authority and bind the highest-value dependency-valid successor while shift time remains. A worker may stop at a runtime/tool boundary only after leaving a current READY successor or an all-rungs-exhausted proof.
repair_rule: A repair that changes subject code creates a new exact SHA and a replacement delegation linked to the failed receipt/delegation. The failed delegation never silently changes subject identity.
authority_boundary: Execution state and scheduling never grant product, canonical-writer, A-01, human, author, private, blind, native, publication or production authority.
